g.text: Turning the report into searches — eight patterns, seven new defects
left: the class established by D1-D6 · centre: the search it becomes · right: what it returned
at a layer that cannot report
in SCSS, checked against what it bounds
so the lint rule covers it all
One false positive, recorded so it is not re-raised.
on list reads has F1's exact shape — a failure
becoming an empty success — and is correct:
and propagates every real error, so an
empty list can never stand in for a failed read.
